create_pptx_backend: create a MsPowerpointDocumentBackend instance to parse a PPTX file into a structured DoclingDocument
convert_pptx_to_docling: convert a PowerPoint PPTX file into a DoclingDocument with slides, text, tables, and images
extract_pptx_tables: extract tables from a PowerPoint slide shape including row spans, column spans, and cell text
parse_pptx_lists: parse bullet and numbered list items from PowerPoint slide shapes into structured list groups
extract_pptx_images: extract embedded images from PowerPoint slide shapes as PIL ImageRef objects with DPI metadata
